scope: Optional actual-catalog validated activation, strict registry-instance binding and checked single-attempt audit preparation. Local contracts/HTTPS; no durable-provider/outbox/atomic-transaction/exactlyonce/production/benchmark qualification.
limits: Old direct activation/recording keeps latevalidation unless application adopts new flow.
Prepare is not transaction reservation/provider readiness or forced completion; callers must await Complete after effects.
Abandonment can leave changed data with zero trail; late retained-context completion denies.
New immutable policies do not revoke preparations bound to old owners.
One facade append attempt per capability is not backend exactlyonce.
Pre-effect failure inside an existing handler proves mutation0, not handlerfactory0.
baseline: Oldc341 legacy activation sink1, actualmutation1 then missingruleMayHaveCommitted/records0; exactsource/raw retained.
archive_paths: Compact aliases in attempt-path-map.json preserve raw bytes and prevent new Windows path-length failures.
secret_pattern_scan: Passed actual compact JWS/JWE/private PEM patterns; no runtime credentials exported
